summary: Architecture/design phase only -- no Runtime Context implementation, persistence implementation, or execution capability introduced; no file under src/pcae/ touched. First phase of the 112-series. Designs how PCAE models the current operational state of the Runtime while preserving the complete non-executing guarantees established through 111R. Restates the core principle -- Runtime orchestrates, Registry resolves, Plugins implement, Metadata precedes behavior, Visibility precedes authority -- and extends it with this phase's own addition, Context precedes execution: a future execution-capability phase must be able to name the exact session/task/phase/intent/approval/decision an action belongs to before that action could ever be authorized. Defines Runtime Context as the Runtime's dynamic operational model -- describes, never executes -- generalizing 110C section 8's own Dynamic runtime concept and completing the design 111B's deferred SessionInfo/TaskInfo/PhaseInfo needed. Freezes the Persistent vs Session Context split, explicitly clarified as a scope distinction, not a disk-persistence distinction. Freezes twelve context objects, design only: RuntimeContext, RuntimeSession, TaskContext, PhaseContext, IntentContext, ApprovalContext, BrokerDecisionContext, EvidenceContext, ObservationContext, plus three future/stub objects -- ExecutionContext (current state: execution_unavailable), AuditContext, RollbackContext. Freezes a six-stage Context Lifecycle (Created, Initialized, Observed, Updated, Completed, Archived), a third distinct lifecycle vocabulary alongside 110A section 8's Runtime State Model and 110B section 4's Plugin Lifecycle. Freezes ownership: Runtime owns Context lifecycle/current context/transitions; Registry owns metadata; Plugins own capability implementation; Broker owns policy decisions; Context never owns execution, approval decisions, or policy evaluation. Freezes the Context relationship chain, recording two evidence-grounded findings rather than assuming an answer: Task:Phase cardinality is many-to-one, verified directly against this session's own operational pattern; and an ordering tension between Approval and Broker Decision against 110A section 5's frozen Decision Pipeline to Approval interface, named explicitly as an open question for 112B. Freezes a Persistence Model -- the direct, per-concept answer to 111R's recommendation condition: Session/Task/Phase should, and already do, persist; Intent recommended session-only until Evidence exists; Approval and Evidence should eventually persist once implemented; Broker decision and Observation state are deliberately session-only/ephemeral as a continuation of 109B-109D's already-frozen consult-and-discard safety property, persisting them declared explicitly out of 112A's scope. Freezes seven Context invariants, including one named unresolved tension left for 112B. Added docs/PCAE_RUNTIME_CONTEXT_ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/PHASE_112_RUNTIME_CONTEXT_ARCHITECTURE.md. docs/ROADMAP.md evaluated and found to need no change. 156 new tests (tests/test_runtime_context_architecture.py), a pure documentation-verification suite. Focused tests (992), governance/autonomy group (2465), and the release/lifecycle regression subset actually present (1429/1429, excluding the two known-slow phase85/phase87 integration files) all passed under -n auto; fast_green 4390/4390 (matches documented baseline).
